Consistent with others in the industry, the Group monitors capital based on the gearing ratio. This ratio is calculated as debt
divided by total capital. Debt is calculated as ‘Total borrowings’ (including ‘Current and non-current borrowings’ as shown in the
statements of financial position less bank overdrafts). Total capital is calculated as ‘Total equity’ as shown in the statements of
financial position, including non-controlling interests.
